canonical_context.role: context_only; canonical/source movement does not close COST-CI

canonical_cost_ci_contract.missing: Representative complete candidate cost/latency/cache/retry and billed-usage evidence
canonical_cost_ci_contract.reason: R3 acquires84 completed runs/418 jobs across seven newest12-run strata;16 anomalous job times remain unknown. No random/full candidate cohort or earlier-attempt/billing history.
canonical_cost_ci_contract.effect: Measured observations exist, but no organization savings, flake rate or pure queue-time claim follows.
canonical_cost_ci_contract.closure_condition: Collect representative recent PR/MQ/push cohort, sample criteria and timestamps; measure queue/run/capacity/cache/retry/yield before changes.

sampling_design_frozen_before_interpreta.selection: For every listed repository/workflow/event stratum, select the newest five completed runs in the fixed window ordered by created_at descending then run id descending. PR and pull_request_target share the PR class; merge_group requires the actual event; push requires head_branch=main.
inclusions: created_at within the fixed inclusive window
actual event belongs to the named stratum
exclusions: qualifying runs older than the newest-five stratum cap
sampling_design_frozen_before_interpreta.bias_and_scope: Deterministic recent workflow/event-stratified convenience cohort, not random, not a full organization census, and not an account billing cohort. Empty event strata remain missing; no substitution.
sampling_design_frozen_before_interpreta.pagination: At most ten 100-row listing pages per raw event. Each selected run job list was paged until reported total_count was received. listing_complete=false records listing truncation; eligible_count then is only a lower bound.
sampling_design_frozen_before_interpreta.deduplication: A workflow run id may appear once only across all strata; acquisition asserted global uniqueness before job collection. Historical R3 rows are excluded from this current cohort.

provenance.method: authenticated GET only; no workflow dispatch/rerun/cancel, repository/ruleset/queue/provider mutation, billing/admin/secret endpoint, or log download

metric_definitions.run_wall_seconds: updated_at - created_at; a wall proxy including all phases visible between these fields, not billed time and not pure execution/queue time.
metric_definitions.run_start_delay_proxy_seconds: run_started_at - created_at when both exist; a bounded scheduling/start proxy, not pure queue time.
metric_definitions.job_execution_seconds: completed_at - started_at only when non-negative; missing/negative intervals remain UNKNOWN and are excluded from sums/medians.
metric_definitions.job_wait_from_run_creation_seconds: job.started_at - run.created_at when non-negative; includes workflow/job dependency and scheduling effects, not pure runner queue time.
metric_definitions.overlap_observation: Maximum interval overlap among selected jobs with valid [started_at, completed_at) timestamps. This proves observed concurrency only, not configured or available capacity.
metric_definitions.yield: Counts by terminal GitHub conclusion for selected runs/jobs. Cancelled, skipped and failure are separate from success; no repeated-failure classifier or organization flake rate.
metric_definitions.cache: Only job step names containing case-insensitive cache would be recorded. Such a name does not prove hit/miss; no named step means UNKNOWN, not cache miss.
metric_definitions.retry: run_attempt > 1 identifies a workflow rerun. Earlier-attempt metadata is acquired only for such selected runs; it is distinct from job retry, which this API sample does not expose.
metric_definitions.run_timestamp_semantics: GitHub exposed created_at, run_started_at and updated_at for these completed runs; it did not expose a distinct queued_at or completed_at field in the acquired workflow-run representation. updated_at is retained and used only in the declared wall proxy.

cache_evidence.limitation: Job metadata step names only; logs/artifacts were not downloaded. Absence is UNKNOWN, not miss; hit/miss, bytes, restore/save timing and cache yield are not established.

retry_evidence.limitation: Zero selected run_attempt>1 observations is not proof of zero retries outside this sample. No job retry classification or earlier history exists for attempt-1 selections.

billing_and_pricing.reason: Authorized read-only run/job metadata does not establish account billing usage or effective price. Billing/admin endpoints were not called and public list price is not account billing truth. No estimate is made.

historical_r3_separation.summary: R3 remains its separately labeled 84-run/418-job newest-12 sample with 16 anomalous job times. No R3 row is counted in this 60-run current cohort.

allowed: The selected current cohort contains exactly 60 unique completed runs and 263 jobs across the explicitly defined strata.
Within this selected cohort, terminal conclusions and timestamp-derived proxies may be reported exactly as recorded, with anomalous intervals excluded rather than zeroed.
Actual merge-group coverage consists only of runs whose event is merge_group; empty strata remain missing.
Valid interval overlap demonstrates only the observed simultaneous execution in this selected cohort.
not_allowed: organization-wide savings, spend, cost reduction or runner-minute price
organization flake rate or repeated-failure causation
pure queue time or configured/available runner capacity
cache miss/hit/yield from absence of explicit metadata
zero retry rate from absence of selected reruns

smallest_missing_evidence: Representative random or full recent candidate cohort with complete, untruncated inclusion frame across relevant workflows/events.
Runner-queue timestamps or provider-supported semantics separating queue from dependency/setup wait.
Explicit cache hit/miss/bytes/timing evidence sufficient for cache yield.
Complete workflow earlier-attempt and job-retry history with a defensible repeated-failure classifier.
Authorized account billed usage and effective runner pricing/usage attribution.
Capacity configuration or an authorized capacity telemetry source beyond selected interval overlap.

exact_future_closure_evidence.canonical: Collect representative recent PR/MQ/push cohort, sample criteria and timestamps; measure queue/run/capacity/cache/retry/yield before changes.
exact_future_closure_evidence.minimum_addition: Provider CI programmes must predeclare and collect a representative random or full recent PR/MQ/push frame with complete pagination and run/job/queue semantics; explicit cache and complete retry histories; defensible capacity telemetry; and authorized billed usage/effective pricing. Preserve event absences and anomalies. Only then reassess COST-CI.

exact_recheck_triggers: Any sampled repository default-branch commit changes before adoption.
Any sampled workflow id/path/state or event trigger changes before adoption.
Canonical PR #185 head or COST-CI unknown contract changes before adoption.
GitHub reports different run/job/attempt metadata or pagination totals for any included id.
Authorized billing, cache, retry, queue or capacity evidence becomes available.

Any claim attempts to combine historical R3 rows with this cohort, infer merge_group from PR checks, treat anomalies as zero, treat cancelled/skipped as success, or promote cohort metrics to organization-wide claims.
